title: 第3章 小老师才二十岁不可能有坏心思的-《同时被N个S级哨兵盯上怎么办》
content:
第(1/3)页

    谢尘无根本不听他说完，“以你们小队的实力，并不能保护好治愈型向导，安排战斗型向导给你们，难道不应该？”

    “应该个屁！”诺亚都开始爆粗了，“战斗型根本不会做疏导！她来了之后，我们小队被她摁着头做精神控制，有一点不顺心就用精神鞭笞……我们活的还不如几条狗！”

    这话，谢尘无倒是听完了。

    随后他嘴角终于带出了淡淡的笑意，像在幸灾乐祸，“所以，诺亚，你的道歉呢？”

    “没有！”诺亚耍起无赖，“有本事你就去白塔告我！我倒要看看塔里究竟要偏帮离颂到什么程度，凭什么他想要什么就有什么！”

    说完，诺亚一把掀开谢尘无拦路的胳膊。

    快步跑上车，一脚油门开走了，留下一团熏人的尾气。

    秦夙气得不行，对着诺亚离开的方向扬起拳头。

    “莫名其妙！有病！”骂完感觉还能再对号入座一下，补了句，“蛇精病！”

    谢尘无默默看着眼前这个小巧精致的人。

    他身高194，在队里不算最高的。

    但跟秦夙比，他已经算巨人了。

    巨人看小人儿，总能看出很多的乐趣。

    等秦夙的怒气稍微平复，谢尘无才上前一步，“你好，秦夙向导。”

    还伸出了右手。

    秦夙：“……”赶紧整理一下状态。

    干咳一声，找回还算柔和的语调，跟谢尘无握了下手，“你好呀，谢尘无。”

    他挑眉，诺亚叫了他一次，她就记住了他的名字？

    “谢谢你帮我出头。”秦夙大大方方的歪头笑着道谢，眉眼弯弯的，“你的出场，堪称神兵天降，太及时了！”

    谢尘无微微勾起嘴角，这次看起来是真心的了，“是队长让我来的，说你初来乍到，让我来做你的小老师，带带你。”

    “小？”秦夙身体后仰，方便自己把谢尘无从上看到下，“你这个体型，怎么都看不出小啊，你几岁？”

    “二十岁。”谢尘无说。

    那，那还真是小……

    秦夙在地球已经是个年近三十的老阿姨了。

    但萧岑这副身体年轻，才刚十八岁。

    一时间不知道该怎么算自己的年纪才合适，陷入沉思。

    谢尘无又轻轻握了握她的手，“怎么了，有什么疑问吗？”
    第(1/3)页

Page (1/3)

Xie Chenwu didn't even listen to what he said, "With the strength of your team, you can't protect the healing guide. Shouldn't we arrange a combat guide for you?"

"That's bullshit!" Noah started to explode, "The fighting type doesn't know how to guide at all! After she came, our team was held down by her head for mental control, and she used mental whipping if anything didn't go well... We are worse than a few dogs!"

Xie Chenwu has finished listening to these words.

Then, a faint smile finally appeared on his lips, as if he was gloating, "So, Noah, where is your apology?"

"No!" Noah acted like a rogue, "If you can, go to the White Tower and sue me! I want to see how far the tower will go to deviate from others, and why should he get whatever he wants!"

After saying that, Noah lifted Xie Chen’s arm that was not blocking his way.

He quickly ran into the car, stepped on the accelerator and drove away, leaving behind a cloud of smoky exhaust fumes.

Qin Su was so angry that he raised his fist in the direction Noah left.

"It's inexplicable! I'm sick!" After scolding me, I felt like I could take my seat again, so I added, "Snake spirit disease!"

Xie Chenwu silently looked at the small and delicate person in front of him.

He is 1.9cm tall and is not the tallest in the team.

But compared with Qin Su, he is already a giant.

A giant can always see a lot of fun when looking at a little person.

After Qin Su’s anger calmed down a little, Xie Chenwu took a step forward and said, “Hello, guide Qin Su.”

He also extended his right hand.

Qin Su: "..." Quickly sort out the situation.

He coughed dryly, regained his gentle tone, and shook hands with Xie Chenwu, "Hello, Xie Chenwu."

He raised his eyebrows. Noah called him once and she remembered his name?

"Thank you for helping me." Qin Su thanked him with a smile and tilted his head generously, with crooked eyebrows. "Your appearance is like a divine weapon descending from the sky. It was so timely!"

Xie Chenwu raised the corner of his mouth slightly, and this time he seemed to be sincere, "The captain asked me to come. He said that since you are new here, he asked me to be your little teacher and guide you."

"Small?" Qin Su leaned back so that he could see Xie Chenwu from above, "You can't tell how small you are with your size. How old are you?"

"Twenty years old." Xie Chenwu said.

Then, that’s really small...

Qin Su is already an old aunt in her late thirties on Earth.

“But Xiao Cen’s body is young, he is only eighteen years old.

For a moment, I didn’t know how to calculate my age, and I fell into deep thought.

Xie Chenwu gently shook her hand, "What's wrong? Do you have any questions?"
